title: alnus sinuata var. stenophylla
intro: Alnus sinuata var. stenophylla, commonly known as the Rocky Mountain alder, is a plant species in the birch family, characterized by its unique, curved leaves. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Alnus sinuata var. stenophylla include wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and condensed tannins.
